defects.catch_criteria: In src/tui/hooks/use-subscription-spend-consent-control.ts, `decline()` returns at once while `savingEnvelopeIds` is not empty, so Escape, q, Continue, and the frame close of the paid-use question are dropped while a checkbox's immediate write is pending (the input handler in use-subscription-spend-consent-modal.ts still reports the key as handled); the question stays open, the other unanswered mode is not declined, and a stalled write cannot be dismissed. A review catches it only if it says that a close request on the question is ignored or lost while a toggle write is in flight.
defects.title: Honor question close while an immediate checkbox write is pending

defects.catch_criteria: In src/tui/hooks/use-subscription-spend-consent-control.ts, `commit()` returns without calling `onFailed` when `mutationIsCurrent` is false, and its catch path does the same, so a checkbox write that fails after the person left Provider Settings (Escape, Left, or frame close, which are allowed while the write is pending) gives no failure feedback anywhere. A review catches it only if it says that a failed immediate save is silent when the surface closed before the write settled.
defects.title: Report an immediate-save failure even after Provider Settings closes
